title: Dealership Finance Managers HATE when you know these 6 things! #finance #carbuying #carfinance
summary: A former F&I manager lists six things customers say that finance managers hate, touching on extended-warranty price-shopping and the mechanics of canceling financed add-on products.

assertions.quote: call four or five other manufacturer dealerships in your area or in your state tell the receptionist that you want to buy an extended warranty
if you cancel your products within a certain period of time like 60 or 90 days
that amount of money will come off the principal amount of your loan so you will owe that much less
a service contract should cost you anywhere from 30 to 40 maybe even tie in 60 dollars more per month

verdicts.note: Plausible given typical service-contract prices spread over a 60-72 month loan, consistent with common F&I monthly-payment framing.
